findings.issue: כִּי is only an open conjunction; «cuando» selects the temporal sense and closes si/porque.
Qal imperfect 2mp is archaic future subjunctive; the -en ending is ustedes, so the addressee is unchanged.
Plural שְׁלָמִים is aimed at with «pazes», which is not the plural paces, so the plural is blurred.
Suffix is 2mp (your). «su» after Jehová reads as his pleasure, so the addressees’ possessor becomes a third party. «agrado» also locks רָצוֹן to pleasure/will.

notes: Jehová, both qal 2mp verbs, singular זֶבַח, and the 3ms object on the second verb are licensed.
